Ivy Lopez: Heads-up — expo sample using the JS SDK (default import) is failing in the RN dev client on iOS: first request stalls, Metro prints `Unable to resolve module 'node:crypto'` and app ends up in an auth retry loop with repeated 401s.

Marco Diaz: Which SDK bundle are you loading (esm vs cjs)? RN + Hermes often trips on node:crypto imports in ESM bundles.

Ivy Lopez: It's the default package entry, which resolved to ESM in my project. Import line: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. Using Expo SDK 48, Hermes on.

Priya Singh: Two separate issues here: crypto polyfill for RN and fetch-retry semantics. For crypto, add `react-native-get-random-values` or `expo-random` and shim `global.crypto` early. For the retry, RN's fetch can't clone streaming bodies so our SDK's retry wrapper ends up sending an empty body on retry which the backend treats as invalid -> 401.

Ivy Lopez: Quick repro logs: `TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'req.headers.set')` from the retry helper, then `fetch /v1/generate -> 401`.

Marco Diaz: Short-term workarounds: (A) force CJS import `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/dist/cjs/index.js'` to avoid node:crypto in ESM, (B) add a tiny fetch wrapper in the app to buffer `init.body` for RN before potential retries.

Priya Singh: I'm opening a small SDK patch to detect React Native (isReactNative()) and materialize init.body to an ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array before retry attempts. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/498 — WIP.

Ivy Lopez: Metro notes that helped me: add `react-native-get-random-values` to extraNodeModules and import it at app entry. Example snippet in metro.config.js saved my local repro.

Marco Diaz: Also for TypeScript consumers: avoid adding `lib.dom` globally. Instead include a `types/globals.d.ts` in the sample app to stub Blob/ReadableStream types so TS doesn't complain.

build-bot: CI: expo-samples/android-e2e failed on main with `@redwood/inference@0.9.2` — failing tests: sample-app-e2e.

Priya Singh: Action items: 1) I'll convert PR to a hotfix branch and publish a patch once tests pass, 2) DevEx to update the Expo sample README with crypto polyfill + Metro snippet + TS stubs, 3) follow-up to add a `react-native` export or RN-safe ESM build so default import works smoothly.

Ivy Lopez: Will test the hotfix and confirm. Thanks!

(End of thread)
